notes.title: Update 1.1.9 - Kinda-boolean operations and fixes
notes.content:
Added new function: Edit->Intersect. With some extra editing it can help carving objects in one another (you'll need to delete unnecessary triangles and invert some of them).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34090406/03849a69d79e74e0bbb1905a8492900c7ccf0fd8.jpg[/img]

Added a "sort" button in groups panel to sort groups alphabetically

Fixed some of the import/export bugs

notes.title: Update 1.1.8: Animation support
notes.content:
Along with several bug fixes this update brings an ability to create and edit animations.
You can store all animations for specific model in one file.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34090406/aa1e39c1e794ebb904e7bb0238c8fb0829bffed3.jpg[/img]

Keep in mind that this new feature may be still a bit rough at the edges and some things may not work as expected. Feedback is welcome.

At the moment it's confirmed to work with Ostriv assets, GoldSrc .mdl & .smd and Collada file formats.

notes.title: Update 1.1.7: FBX, Collada, Blender and new polygon creation mode
notes.content:
Here we go with some new experimental functionality. I'm sure it'll need some extra work later, but the core is there.
We can now import: .FBX, .DAE, .BLEND
We can now export: .FBX, .DAE
Also we have a new nice feature in Polygon Tool: On surface. It gives an ability to paint polygons right on a surface in 3D view:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34090406/14d7c75e24534d5629750b22246bd2ac4bb712d0.jpg[/img]

They can also be holes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34090406/1db2080de54885a58f2eaae714538056f4fd4327.jpg[/img]

Enjoy and have a nice day.
